secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_DERIV_APP_ID
secrets.description: Deriv app id from https://app.deriv.com/account/api-token / App Registration. Drives OAuth login/sign-up and WebSocket connections. Without it, Log in / Sign up stay disabled (the app still renders).

secrets.name: GD_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Client ID for Drive strategy save/load (optional).

secrets.name: GD_APP_ID
secrets.description: Google project number (App ID) for Drive Picker (optional).

secrets.name: GD_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google API key for Drive API (optional).
